# Unitree SDK2 Python — Go2 deployment subset

Source: https://github.com/unitreerobotics/unitree_sdk2_python

This directory contains the SDK modules imported by the Go2 driver, including their DDS message dependencies. Other robot clients and examples are omitted. See [the robot setup guide](../../README.md) for installation and execution. The upstream [BSD-3-Clause license](LICENSE) is retained.
